videos.descricao:
His grandfather asked him for one afternoon under the cherry blossoms. Kenji kept saying "next time", at dinner, at the photo album, even on his birthday. This is a short animated story about the people we put off, and the Japanese word for what he learned too late.

Animated stories about discipline, with one Japanese idea in every film.
